claim: 大约三分之一的偏头痛患者有「先兆」：头痛前出现短暂的视觉、感觉或语言症状，最常见的是视觉
quote: About one-third of persons with migraine experience transient neurologic symptoms, referred to as aura.
source: Clinical features of migraine with aura: a REFORM study, J Headache Pain 2024

claim: 先兆通常持续 5 到 60 分钟
quote: reversible ... visual, sensory, speech, and motor symptoms, usually lasting 5–60 minutes
source: Della Volta et al., Cephalalgia 2024（先兆管理综述）

claim: 1941 年，心理学家卡尔·拉什利（Karl Lashley）在自己偏头痛发作时画下眼前的闪光，推算出大脑视觉皮层里有一个过程以约每分钟 3 毫米的速度移动
quote: he meticulously mapped his aura ... concluded that the cortical process progressed at a speed of 3 mm/min across the visual cortex
source: Lashley KS, Arch Neurol Psychiatry 1941;46:331–339（转引 MDedge Neurology）

claim: 1944 年，巴西科学家莱昂（Aristides Leão）在兔子大脑皮层上发现：一处受刺激后，电活动像熄灯一样，一波一波向四周慢慢扩散，速度是每分钟几毫米；他当时并不知道拉什利的论文
quote: Despite being totally unaware of Lashley's publication 3 years earlier, Leão noticed the similarity of this spreading depression to the migraine aura.
source: Leão AAP, J Neurophysiol 1944;7:359–390（转引 MDedge Neurology；Leão 本人 Citation Classic 回顾）

claim: 2001 年，哈佛团队用功能磁共振在人脑视觉皮层直接看到了这道波：每分钟约 3.5 毫米，走的位置和患者眼前闪光的位置一致
quote: the BOLD change progressed contiguously and slowly (3.5 +/- 1.1 mm/min) over occipital cortex, congruent with the retinotopy of the visual percept

claim: 1990 年，埃德温森（Lars Edvinsson）和戈兹比（Peter Goadsby）发现：偏头痛发作时，颈静脉血里一种叫 CGRP 的分子升高
quote: elevated levels of CGRP in the jugular vein were found to occur during migraine attacks
source: Goadsby PJ, Edvinsson L, Ekman R, Ann Neurol 1990;28:183–187（后来有研究未能重复，见 Tvedskov 2005）

claim: 2002 年，奥列森（Jes Olesen）团队给 12 位偏头痛患者静脉输注 CGRP：之后 11 小时内 12 人全部头痛（安慰剂 1 人），其中 3 人出现了符合标准的偏头痛发作
quote: During the following 11 h all patients experienced headaches after halphaCGRP vs. one patient after placebo ... In three patients after halphaCGRP, but in no patients after placebo, the delayed headache fulfilled the IHS criteria for migraine without aura.

claim: 2018 年 5 月 17 日，美国 FDA 批准了第一个专门阻断 CGRP 通路、用于预防偏头痛的药物（每月注射一次）
quote: FDA approved Aimovig (erenumab-aooe) ... the first FDA-approved preventive migraine drug in a new class that blocks calcitonin gene-related peptide (CGRP) activity

claim: 关键试验 STRIVE（955 人，6 个月）：高剂量组 50% 的人每月偏头痛天数至少减半，安慰剂组是 26.6%
quote: Half of patients on the 140 mg dose cut their monthly migraine days by at least half, versus 26.6% on placebo.
source: Goadsby PJ et al., NEJM 2017（STRIVE）；Novartis 新闻稿 2017-11-29

claim: 2021 年 Brain Prize（脑科学界奖金最高的奖之一，1000 万丹麦克朗）授予埃德温森、戈兹比、莫斯科维茨、奥列森四人，表彰他们发现 CGRP 在偏头痛中的作用
quote: The four migraine pioneers receive the prize of DKK 10 million for their discovery of an essential mechanism causing migraine attacks.

claim: 2021 年全球约 11.6 亿人患有偏头痛（全球疾病负担研究 GBD 2021）
quote: prevalence increased by 58.15%, from 732.56 million to 1.16 billion cases
source: GBD 2021 偏头痛负担分析，J Headache Pain 2024

claim: 偏头痛女性更多见，可能和激素有关；常见于 35 到 45 岁
quote: It is more common in women, possibly because of hormonal influences. ... generally affects those aged between 35 and 45 years
source: WHO 头痛障碍事实清单
